preconditions.description: Input x must be a string.

postconditions.description: The output string has the same length as the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == x[i] for i in range(len(x)) if len(x) % 2 == 1 and i == len(x) // 2)
postconditions.description: If the input string has odd length, the middle character remains unchanged.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == x[len(x) - 1 - j] and return_value[len(x) - 1 - j] == x[i] for i in range(len(x) // 2) for j in range(len(x) // 2))
postconditions.description: For each pair of characters at positions i and len(x)-1-i, the output swaps them (moves internal letters out and external letters in).
